scoring.description: For each orientation, add up the Likert scores (1-5) of every question tagged with that orientation. This gives one raw score per orientation.

normalization.description: Converts each orientation's raw sum into a 0-1 score so orientations can be compared fairly, even if they end up with different numbers of questions in future versions of the question bank.

dominant.rule: The orientation with the highest normalized score.

secondary.rule: The orientation with the second-highest normalized score.

shadow.rule: The orientation with the lowest normalized score.

tieBreaking.description: If two or more orientations are tied at a rank boundary, the one listed earlier in 'orientations' above is treated as the higher rank.
